name: novel-dialogue
description: Draft or revise dialogue inside an assigned scene while preserving character knowledge, voice, agenda, and subtext.
procedure: Identify each speaker's current knowledge, agenda, leverage, and forbidden disclosures.
Write compressed dialogue in which competing wants alter the scene state.
Apply changes only within the assigned chapter/scene scope and report evidence.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
